blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A logistics network is the set of places and routes a company uses to move its goods. The places are usually warehouses, hubs, and distribution centres. The routes are the roads, rails, sea lanes, or flight paths that connect them.

A simple network has one warehouse and a few delivery routes. A large network may have dozens of hubs, hundreds of routes, and three or four modes of transport working together.

Good networks are designed, not accidental. They match how the company wants to serve its customers.

items.q: What is a logistics network made of?
items.why: "the set of places and routes a company uses to move its goods."

items.q: Which of these is a route in the network?
items.why: Routes = roads, rails, sea lanes, flight paths. A sea lane is a route.

items.q: How many warehouses does a simple network have?
items.why: "A simple network has one warehouse and a few delivery routes."

items.q: The text suggests that a good network is…
items.why: Inferência: "Good networks are designed, not accidental" — feito de propósito, não por acaso.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: Large networks can have many hubs and routes.
The network should fit how the company serves its customers.
A network just happens on its own, with no plan.
A network can use more than one mode of transport.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que boas redes são desenhadas, não acidentais — ele discordaria de que a rede "acontece sozinha".

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry explicando o mapa ao novo analista. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, come and sit here. Let me show you our network on this map. It is simple. We have five warehouses. I will draw them as boxes.

This one, in the middle, is our main hub. All the big routes go through it. The other four warehouses are around it. Look — one is in the north, one is in the south, one is near the port, and one is by the airport.

Now the routes. The line from the hub to the north warehouse is a road. Goods go by truck on that one. The line to the port warehouse is a sea lane, because we send some goods by ship. The line to the airport is a flight path.

So we move goods by road, by sea, and by air. Three modes. The hub connects all of them. If you understand this map, you understand where our costs come from. Take a photo of it, and we will look at the routes again tomorrow.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many warehouses does Harry draw on the map?
items.why: "We have five warehouses."

items.q: Where is the main hub on the map?
items.why: "This one, in the middle, is our main hub."

items.q: How do goods travel to the port warehouse?
items.why: "The line to the port warehouse is a sea lane, because we send some goods by ship."

items.q: Harry says the map helps the analyst understand…
options: where the company's costs come from
items.why: "If you understand this map, you understand where our costs come from."

items.q: Why does the hub matter so much in Harry's network?
options: It has no routes at all
It is the only place with trucks
It connects all the routes and modes
items.why: Inferência: "All the big routes go through it" e "The hub connects all of them" — o hub liga tudo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We keep the boxes in the warehouse before we ship them." A warehouse is…
options: a building where goods are stored
items.why: Warehouse = armazém, o prédio onde as mercadorias ficam guardadas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The main ___ in the middle connects all the other warehouses."
items.why: Hub = centro que liga as outras partes da rede.

items.q: "There is a fast route from the port to the city." A route is…
options: a way that goods travel from one place to another
a place where goods are stored
items.why: Route = rota, o caminho pelo qual as mercadorias viajam.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We send some goods by ship, so we use a ___."
items.why: Sea lane = rota marítima, usada quando os produtos vão por navio.

items.q: "A good network helps us serve our customers well." To serve means to…
items.why: To serve = atender, dar serviço aos clientes.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em reuniões de logística. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the new route." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the new map next month." To roll out means to…
options: start using it, step by step
items.why: Roll out = colocar em uso aos poucos.

items.q: "Let's set up a new warehouse near the port." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = montar, começar algo novo.

items.q: "Two drivers pushed back on the new route." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, não concordar com algo.

items.q: "We need to keep track of every route on the map." This means to…
items.why: Keep track of = acompanhar, não perder de vista.
